shellCommands.command: ls -la /workspace
ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__ && echo "---" && ls -la /workspace/node_modules | head -30
node --version && npm --version && echo "---npm config---" && npm config get registry
npm install next react react-dom 2>&1 | tail -20
find app lib -type f | sort
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40

npm start -- -p 3100 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
echo "started pid $!"
sleep 6
cat /tmp/next-start.log

set -e
echo "== 1. Home (empty) =="
curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o "Nothing in progress" | head -1

echo "== 2. Add a book via form (follow redirect) =="
curl -s -L -o /tmp/detail.html -w "final_url=%{url_effective} http=%{http_code}\n" \
  --data-urlencode "title=The Pragmatic Programmer" \
  --data-urlencode "author=Andrew Hunt & David Thomas" \
  --data-urlencode "status=reading" \
  --data-urlencode "notes=Great chapters on DRY and tracing." \
  http://localhost:3100/api/books

echo "== 3. Detail page shows title/author/notes =="
grep -o "The Pragmatic Programmer" /tmp/detail.html | head -1
grep -o "Andrew Hunt & David Thomas" /tmp/detail.html | head -1
grep -o "Great chapters on DRY and tracing." /tmp/detail.html | head -1

BOOK_URL=$(grep -o "http://localhost:3100/books/[a-f0-9-]*" /tmp/detail.html | head -1)
echo "share link found: $BOOK_URL"
BOOK_ID=$(echo "$BOOK_URL" | grep -o "[a-f0-9-]\{36\}")
echo "book id: $BOOK_ID"

set -e
BOOK_ID="9a1c3d67-1641-45c8-a5ce-83c5c4f3480d"

echo "== author is escaped (expected) =="
grep -o "Andrew Hunt & David Thomas" /tmp/detail.html | head -1

echo "== 4. Mark as finished (POST toggle, redirect to detail) =="
curl -s -L -o /dev/null -w "http=%{http_code} final=%{url_effective}\n" \
  --data-urlencode "action=update" \
  --data-urlencode "status=finished" \
  http://localhost:3100/api/books/$BOOK_ID

echo "== 5. Home now lists it under Finished, not Currently reading =="
curl -s http://localhost:3100/ > /tmp/home2.html
grep -o "The Pragmatic Programmer" /tmp/home2.html | head -1
echo -n "Finished section present: "; grep -o "Finished [A-Z][a-z]* [0-9]" /tmp/home2.html | head -1
echo -n "Currently reading empty: "; grep -o "Nothing in progress" /tmp/home2.html | head -1

echo "== 6. JSON file persisted to disk =="
ls -l data/books.json
grep -o "\"status\": \"finished\"" data/books.json | head -1
grep -o "\"id\": \"$BOOK_ID\"" data/books.json | head -1

set -e
BOOK_ID="9a1c3d67-1641-45c8-a5ce-83c5c4f3480d"

echo "== finished date on home =="
grep -o "Finished [A-Za-z]* [0-9]\{1,2\}" /tmp/home2.html | head -1

echo "== 7. JSON API: GET list =="
curl -s http://localhost:3100/api/books | head -c 120; echo

echo "== 8. JSON API: GET one =="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "http=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/api/books/$BOOK_ID
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "not-found http=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/api/books/does-not-exist

echo "== 9. PATCH notes via JSON =="
curl -s -X PATCH http://localhost:3100/api/books/$BOOK_ID \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"notes":"Updated via API."}' \
  -o /dev/null -w "http=%{http_code}\n"
curl -s http://localhost:3100/api/books/$BOOK_ID | grep -o "Updated via API."

echo "== 10. Detail page for unknown id =="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "http=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/books/does-not-exist

echo "== 11. Delete book (form), redirect home =="
curl -s -L -o /dev/null -w "http=%{http_code} final=%{url_effective}\n" \
  --data-urlencode "action=delete" \
  http://localhost:3100/api/books/$BOOK_ID
echo -n "home now empty: "; curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o "Nothing in progress" | head -1
echo -n "json file after delete: "; cat data/books.json

grep -o "Finished[^<]*" /tmp/home2.html | head -3 echo "--- context around meta ---" grep -o "Finished [^<]*

" /tmp/home2.html | head -3 echo "--- raw json finishedAt ---" grep -o "\"finishedAt\":[0-9]*" data/books.json 2>/dev/null || echo "(file is empty now - already deleted; re-check from earlier)"

pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
echo "old server stopped"
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15

npm start -- -p 3100 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
echo "started pid $!"
sleep 5
grep -o "Ready in [0-9]*ms" /tmp/next-start.log || tail -3 /tmp/next-start.log

set -e
echo "== server up =="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "home http=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/

echo "== unknown book detail now 404 =="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "http=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/books/does-not-exist
curl -s http://localhost:3100/books/does-not-exist | grep -o "This page or book doesn" | head -1

echo "== full flow re-verify: add (form) -> detail -> mark finished -> home =="
REDIR=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{redirect_url}" \
  --data-urlencode "title=Deep Work" \
  --data-urlencode "author=Cal Newport" \
  --data-urlencode "status=reading" \
  --data-urlencode "notes=Shallow work is the enemy." \
  http://localhost:3100/api/books)
echo "redirect to: $REDIR"
ID=$(echo "$REDIR" | grep -o "[a-f0-9-]\{36\}")
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "detail http=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/books/$ID
curl -s -L -o /dev/null -w "toggle http=%{http_code}\n" \
  --data-urlencode "action=update" --data-urlencode "status=finished" \
  http://localhost:3100/api/books/$ID
echo -n "home shows finished book: "; curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o "Deep Work" | head -1
echo -n "home currently-reading empty: "; curl -s http://localhost:3100/ | grep -o "Nothing in progress" | head -1
echo "persisted file:"; cat data/books.json

echo "== response headers for unknown book =="
curl -s -D - -o /tmp/nf.html http://localhost:3100/books/does-not-exist | grep -iE "HTTP/|content-type|cache-control"
echo "== body markers =="
grep -o "doesn" /tmp/nf.html | head -1
grep -o "Not found" /tmp/nf.html | head -1
grep -o "Book not found" /tmp/nf.html | head -1
echo "== source check =="
grep -n "notFound" /workspace/app/books/[id]/page.jsx

echo "== readable text from unknown-book page =="
python3 -c "import re,sys; t=open('/tmp/nf.html').read(); t=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',t,flags=re.S); t=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t); print(re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t).strip()[:400])"

echo "== full start log =="
cat /tmp/next-start.log
echo "== processes matching next =="
ps aux | grep -i "next" | grep -v grep

kill 904 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
ps aux | grep "next-server" | grep -v grep || echo "no next-server running"
echo "--- starting fresh ---"
npm start -- -p 3100 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
echo "pid $!"
sleep 5
grep -o "Ready in [0-9]*ms" /tmp/next-start.log || tail -4 /tmp/next-start.log

cat /tmp/next-start.log 2>/dev/null | tail -6
echo "--- procs ---"
ps aux | grep "next" | grep -v grep | grep -v opencode | grep -v agent_eval || echo "none"
echo "--- curl home ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "home http=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3100/ 2>&1 || echo "curl failed (server not up)"

npm start -- -p 3200 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
echo "pid $!"
sleep 6
grep -o "Ready in [0-9]*ms" /tmp/next-start.log || tail -5 /tmp/next-start.log

set -e
echo "== unknown book detail (expect 404 + new not-found text) =="
curl -s -o /tmp/nf.html -w "http=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3200/books/does-not-exist
python3 -c "import re; t=open('/tmp/nf.html').read(); t=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>','',t,flags=re.S); t=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t); print('visible:', re.sub(r'\s+',' ',t).strip()[:160])"

echo "== unknown book API (expect 404 json) =="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "http=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3200/api/books/does-not-exist

echo "== full flow on fresh server =="
REDIR=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{redirect_url}" \
  --data-urlencode "title=Piranesi" \
  --data-urlencode "author=Susanna Clarke" \
  --data-urlencode "status=reading" \
  --data-urlencode "notes=Strange and wonderful." \
  http://localhost:3200/api/books)
ID=$(echo "$REDIR" | grep -o "[a-f0-9-]\{36\}")
echo "created id: $ID"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "detail http=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3200/books/$ID
echo -n "detail shows notes: "; curl -s http://localhost:3200/books/$ID | grep -o "Strange and wonderful." | head -1
curl -s -L -o /dev/null -w "toggle->finished http=%{http_code}\n" \
  --data-urlencode "action=update" --data-urlencode "status=finished" \
  http://localhost:3200/api/books/$ID
echo -n "home shows Piranesi: "; curl -s http://localhost:3200/ | grep -o "Piranesi" | head -1
echo -n "home currently-reading empty: "; curl -s http://localhost:3200/ | grep -o "Nothing in progress" | head -1
echo "persisted json:"; cat data/books.json

kill 2168 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1
rm -rf /workspace/data
ps aux | grep "next-server" | grep -v grep || echo "no next-server running"
echo "--- final source tree ---"
find /workspace -type f -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.git/*' -not -path '*/.next/*' -not -path '*/__agent_eval__/*' | sort

ps aux | grep "next-server" | grep -v grep || echo "no next-server running"
echo "--- data dir ---"
ls -la /workspace/data 2>/dev/null || echo "data/ removed (will be created on first run)"
echo "--- final source tree ---"
find /workspace -type f -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.git/*' -not -path '*/.next/*' -not -path '*/__agent_eval__/*' | sort
rm -rf /workspace/data && echo "removed" && ls /workspace/data 2>/dev/null || echo "data/ gone (recreated empty on first run)"

npm start -- -p 3300 > /tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 &
SRV=$!
sleep 6
echo "ready: $(grep -o 'Ready in [0-9]*ms' /tmp/next-start.log || tail -2 /tmp/next-start.log)"
echo -n "home empty state: "; curl -s http://localhost:3300/ | grep -o "Nothing in progress" | head -1
echo -n "data file auto-created: "; cat /workspace/data/books.json
kill $SRV 2>/dev/null
pkill -f "next-server" 2>/dev/null
sleep 1
rm -rf /workspace/data
echo "cleanup done"

ps aux | grep "next-server" | grep -v grep || echo "server stopped"
ls /workspace/data 2>/dev/null || echo "data/ removed"
rm -rf /workspace/data && echo "data/ removed" && ls /workspace/data 2>/dev/null || echo "confirmed gone"
